children: RNS Number : 4127V  All Active Asset Capital Limited  18 September 2026
Steven Smith has been appointed to the Board of AAA as a Non-Executive Director.

Following a degree in Commerce from the University of Liverpool, Steven qualified as a Chartered Accountant in 1983 while at BDO and subsequently as a Chartered Tax Adviser while at KPMG. He lectured in Taxation at the Financial Training Company for four years and then held a number of senior financial positions at large public and private groups.
For the last 24 years, Steven has been a close adviser to Nick Candy and he currently runs Candy Ventures Sarl (‘CVS’) from its base in Luxembourg. CVS is a significant investor in AAA.
Steven has simultaneously been appointed to the Board of Sentiance N.V., the Belgian predictive AI business, which is AAA’s key investment asset.

James Normand, AAA Chairman, commented: "We are pleased to welcome Steven to the Board at this significant time for AAA and for Sentiance, as it continues its rapid progress. Steven’s skills and experience will be particularly well suited to guide AAA’s plans to generate value and liquidity for AAA shareholders in the future.”
